Corollary
[From Ricci--DeTurck to Ricci flow (Corollary 35.29)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0318 ↗ lem:chow-iv-deturck-diffeomorphism-convergence 1. ch35:35.29\group Dynamic Stability

If Ricci--DeTurck flow near a flat metric converges exponentially to a flat metric, then Ricci flow with the same initial data also converges exponentially to a flat metric.
